name: tokenmaxr-dashboard
description: Builds the tokenmaxr GitHub Pages dashboard (pages/dashboard) into pages/site and the collector's embedded copy.

scripts.check:pages: node scripts/sync-pages-site.mjs --check && node --test scripts/sync-pages-site.test.mjs && tsc -p pages/dashboard/tsconfig.json && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings pages/dashboard/githubSource.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings pages/dashboard/accountUsage.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings pages/dashboard/quota.test.ts
